Would you like to know more about this job with flexible working hours? 📅 Then read on! 👇

What we offer
- Salary up to € 18,83 per hour (from 21 years)
- Long term employment possibilities
- Internal training opportunities
- Full-time, and part-time options
- Travel expenses
- An in-house Tempo-Team office!

Who you are
As a delivery driver at Albert Heijn, you are customer-friendly. You are also physically strong enough to lift heavy crates. What is also important:

- You have a B driving license;
- You speak Dutch or English;
- You have your own transportation to work in Breda and Roosendaal.

What will you do
As a delivery driver at Albert Heijn, no day is the same! You never know where your adventure will take you that day. First, you start by getting your route list and important tools. Everything is ready for you at the distribution point. Don't forget to bring something tasty from the fridge for the road! Yum! :) Once you're going, your navigation will tell you exactly where to go! Have you arrived at your destination? Then you scan the groceries and deliver it to the door with a smile. A smile makes everyone happy! :) After you've delivered all the groceries, it's time to return to the distribution center. Tomorrow is another day!

Where will you work
The location where you will work as a delivery driver at Albert Heijn is Zoete Inval 6 in Breda. This is easy to reach with your own transport! You don't work alone, but together with a friendly team. Everyone has their own route, but beforehand everyone comes together for a cup of coffee. Start your career in European inland shipping with Vario Shipping Group 
Would you like to start a career in inland shipping, even if you do not yet have a Boatman qualification? 
Vario Shipping Group is looking for motivated candidates from Slovakia who would like to join our vessels and 
develop towards becoming a qualified Boatman in European inland shipping. 
You do not need to be a qualified Boatman when you apply. We are looking for people with the right 
motivation, attitude and willingness to learn. 
Your role on board 
As a member of our deck crew, you will be involved in the safe and efficient daily operation of the vessel. 
• Mooring and unmooring the vessel 
• Deck work and general maintenance 
• Assisting with loading and unloading operations 
• Keeping the vessel and working areas clean, organised and safe 
• Following safety procedures and instructions from the Captain 
• Working together with colleagues from different nationalities 
• Supporting the crew in the daily operation of the vessel 
As you gain experience and qualifications, your responsibilities can grow with you. 
Who are we looking for? 
We are looking for someone who: 
• Is motivated to work in European inland shipping 
• Is comfortable working and living on board for several weeks at a time 
• Is practical, responsible and safety-conscious 
• Enjoys working as part of an international team 
• Is willing to learn and develop professionally 
• Has sufficient English to communicate safely and effectively on board 
Experience in inland shipping, maritime work or a technical environment is an advantage, but not essential for 
every candidate. 
Experience on tanker vessels is also an advantage. 
Vario Shipping Group | EURES Recruitment – Slovakia 
Already qualified? 
If you already hold a recognised Boatman qualification for European inland shipping, we would be happy to 
hear from you. 
Your previous experience and qualifications will be taken into account when discussing your position and 
employment conditions. 
Training towards the Boatman qualification 
You do not need to hold the Boatman qualification when you apply. 
If you have the right motivation and are interested in building a career in inland shipping, Vario will look at the 
possibilities for you to develop towards the Boatman qualification. 
We will first explore whether the required training and examination can be completed in Slovakia. 
If a suitable route is not available in Slovakia, you must be willing to follow the necessary Boatman training and 
examination in English in the Netherlands. 
Vario Shipping Group will support you in finding an appropriate training route and in your further professional 
development.

Work on exciting hydrographic and geophysical projects for new developments of offshore windfarms, salvage, large infrastructural projects and climate adaptation or coastal defence work.

When you join us, you will operate mainly in Europe, but Deep’s aim is to have fun at work and therefore we always look for international projects to challenge Deepers to go out to places we haven’t been before. Good examples are our Antarctica survey, port surveys in Djibouti, or an UXO survey in Taiwan.

Deep also supports salvage companies when emergencies are at hand, this results in challenging projects all around the world. You will do this surrounded by an experienced team and supported by highly skilled colleagues so you can learn the ins and outs of the specialized survey equipment and advanced techniques.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES.
Project Preparations: Conduct project preparations and risk assessments.

Vessel Mobilisation: Mobilise and calibrate survey vessels.

Data Acquisition: Acquire and quality control hydrographic data.

Equipment Maintenance: Maintain survey equipment.

Data Processing: Process collected data.

Reporting: Handle reporting and project administration.

WHAT WE ASK.
3+ years experience in a similar position

Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Ocean Technology or similar

Pro-active, practical and flexible mindset

Professional, solution-oriented attitude

Experience with Qinsy

In possession of a valid driver’s license (B, preferably incl. BE)

Fluency in English, both written and verbal

You live, or want to live, in the Netherlands

You are eligable to work in the Netherlands.

You'll be responsible for all geophysical related tasks/aspects of a project. This includes everything from project preparations (geological desktop study, survey planning etc.), execution of the fieldwork and data analysis (QA/QC), to data processing, reporting and charting.

You should be able to collaborate with colleagues as part of a (project) team but also feel comfortable working independently without supervision.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES.
- Survey Operations: Execute various geophysical survey operations in line with internal procedures and client specifications.
- Vessel Mobilisation: Mobilise and calibrate survey vessels.
- Data Processing: Process geophysical survey data, create charts, and write reports.
- Equipment Maintenance: Maintain measuring instruments and survey equipment.
- Administrative Duties: Handle administrative requirements at the project level.

WHO WE LOOK FOR.
We are looking for a candidate with a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Geophysics or Geology, with at least five years experience in a similar position. Good interpersonal skills and the ability to work both independently and within a team are essentials.

WHAT WE ASK.
- Bachelor’s/Master’s Degree in Geophysics, Geology or a related Earth Science.
- 5+ years of experience in a similar position.
- In possession of a valid driver’s license (B, preferably incl. BE).
- Fluency in English, both written and verbal.
- Knowledge of side scan sonar, sub bottom profiler, magnetometer acquisition and processing.

Core competencies: accurate, very flexible, a team-player, good interpersonal skills.
